Useful to know

Questions, answered
with clarity.

Is this an official booking platform?+

No. This is a private concept demonstration. All trips, fares, capacities, bookings, and contacts are sample data until KelvJessia authorizes launch.

Can I make a real payment here?+

No. Payments are intentionally unavailable in this concept. A future Paystack integration must be authorized and verified server-side.

Will a reservation confirm a seat?+

No. The demo creates a local simulated request only. In production, a reservation remains pending until KelvJessia reviews it.

How do I arrange group transport?+

Use “Prepare an enquiry” to compose the information a support team would need. A verified WhatsApp Business number is required before launch.
